details: Duplicate recommendation for one contact and article counts once
Duplicate invites count once; drafts, demo and revoked excluded
Only verified guest counts; demo, self, review and cancellation excluded
Multiple contact actions count as one conversation
Multiple actions count one active day without MySQL timezone tables
Shared Forever number counts exactly once
Shared CC remains hidden until every linked account opts in
Shared account appears once after all owners opt in
CC months never leak into another month
Events outside selected window are excluded
